title: Entra ID sign-in log detail record
event_type: Entra ID SigninLogs schema, single sign-in event detail view

callouts.explanation: Non-zero result codes like 50126 (invalid username or password) distinguish a bad-credential attempt from other failure classes such as expired accounts or conditional-access denials that also produce non-zero codes.
The primary pivot for volumetric brute-force and spray detections, even though it's cheap for an attacker to rotate via proxy or VPN infrastructure.
Shows whether policy evaluation (including MFA) blocked the sign-in, which is the field that separates a merely failed password attempt from one that was also denied by conditional access.
Only populated when device registration or Intune enrollment is turned on; an unregistered device on a sensitive app is a common new-device/account-takeover signal.
